nodeTypes.name: assert
nodeTypes.label: Assert
nodeTypes.description: Fail the run when a comparison doesn't hold; otherwise pass files through.

params.name: value
params.label: Value
params.description: What to check, usually a template such as {{node.<id>.<key>}}. With {{item.<key>}} or {{file}} (the file's name) it is checked once per incoming file, and no files means nothing to check.

params.name: op
params.label: Comparison
params.description: How value is compared to expected. after and before compare RFC 3339 times.

params.name: expected
params.label: Expected
params.description: What the value is compared to.

params.name: message
params.label: Message
params.description: Put before the reasons when the check fails, so the failure says what was checked.

nodeTypes.name: edit-fields
nodeTypes.label: Edit Fields
nodeTypes.description: Set fields on each item from templates over its other fields; files pass through.

params.name: values
params.label: Values
params.description: Field name to value. A value can read the item's other fields, e.g. {{item.first}} {{item.last}}; one that is exactly {{item.<key>}} keeps that field's type. Templates read the fields the item arrived with, and one it lacks fails the run.

params.name: keepOnlySet
params.label: Keep Only Set Fields
params.description: When on, each item keeps only the fields set in values; every other field it carried is dropped.

nodeTypes.name: file-collect
nodeTypes.label: Collect Files
nodeTypes.description: Traverse a directory and collect files matching a glob pattern into the pipeline.

params.name: pattern
params.label: Pattern
params.description: Glob pattern to match files (e.g., "*.jpg", "**/*.svg"). Default: "*" (all files).

params.name: recursive
params.label: Recursive
params.description: Traverse subdirectories when collecting files.

params.name: flatten
params.label: Flatten
params.description: Strip directory structure from output filenames. When true, all files appear as if in the same directory.

nodeTypes.name: file-copy
nodeTypes.label: Copy Files
nodeTypes.description: Place output files in a destination directory with conflict handling.

params.name: destination
params.label: Destination
params.description: Directory path to copy files into.

params.name: create_dirs
params.label: Create Directories
params.description: Automatically create the destination directory if it doesn't exist.

params.name: conflict
params.label: Conflict Resolution
params.description: What to do when a file with the same name already exists. "newer" copies only when the destination is missing or older than the source (path input only), keeps the source's modified time, and never deletes.

params.name: tolerance_ms
params.label: Time Tolerance
params.description: Modified-time gap treated as equal in "newer" mode; FAT and Google Drive round times.

nodeTypes.name: file-decode
nodeTypes.label: Decode Files
nodeTypes.description: Decode each file's content from a text encoding (base64) into its bytes.

params.name: encoding
params.label: Encoding
params.description: The text encoding each file is in. base64 is the standard alphabet (+ and /), padded or not; whitespace and line breaks are ignored. URL-safe base64 (- and _) is not accepted.

params.name: filename
params.label: Output Filename
params.description: Name for each decoded file. {{name}} is the input's name without its last extension and {{ext}} that extension, e.g. {{name}}.json. Leave empty to keep the input's name.

nodeTypes.name: file-delete
nodeTypes.label: Delete Files
nodeTypes.description: Delete the files flowing in, each under a base folder; missing files are skipped and counted.

params.name: base
params.label: Base Folder
params.description: Folder every deleted file must be under. A file outside it (including through ".." or a link) refuses the run, so nothing is deleted.

nodeTypes.name: file-filter
nodeTypes.label: Filter Files
nodeTypes.description: Keep or drop files by extension, name or path pattern, and size.

params.name: extensions
params.label: Extensions
params.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to keep (e.g., "jpg,png,svg"). Leave empty to allow all extensions.

params.name: name_pattern
params.label: Name Pattern
params.description: Glob pattern to match against filenames (e.g., "photo*", "*.backup.*"). Uses glob syntax with * and ? wildcards.

params.name: pattern_mode
params.label: Pattern Mode
params.description: How to interpret the name pattern.

params.name: match
params.label: Match Against
params.description: What the name pattern is tested against: the file's name, or its whole relative path (folders separated by /).

params.name: keep
params.label: Keep Matches
params.description: When on, files matching every criterion are kept and the rest dropped. When off, matching files are dropped and the rest kept.

params.name: min_size
params.label: Minimum Size
params.description: Minimum file size in bytes. Files smaller than this are dropped.

params.name: max_size
params.label: Maximum Size
params.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Files larger than this are dropped. 0 means no limit.

nodeTypes.name: file-join
nodeTypes.label: Join Files
nodeTypes.description: Join the files flowing in into one file, in arrival order (edge order when several steps feed it), a separator between them.

params.name: filename
params.label: File Name
params.description: Name of the joined file, e.g. README.md; its MIME type follows the extension. Reads run templates such as {{vars.X}}.

params.name: separator
params.label: Separator
params.description: Put between files, as written (a newline, a blank line, ---). Not before the first or after the last. Empty joins them directly.

nodeTypes.name: file-list
nodeTypes.label: List Files
nodeTypes.description: Turn lists of paths into files under a base folder; every path is listed, found or missing.

params.name: paths
params.label: Paths
params.description: Paths to list, relative to the base folder, added to any read from input files (one per line, or NUL-separated).

params.name: base
params.label: Base Folder
params.description: Folder the listed paths are relative to. Defaults to the working directory; absolute paths and ".." are refused.

nodeTypes.name: file-metadata
nodeTypes.label: File Metadata
nodeTypes.description: Extract file metadata (folder, size, extension, MIME type, modified time, hash) and attach to output.

params.name: include_hash
params.label: Include Hash
params.description: Compute and include a SHA-256 hash of the file content.

nodeTypes.name: file-move
nodeTypes.label: Move Files
nodeTypes.description: Move files into folders under a destination, by the path in each file's name.

params.name: destination
params.label: Destination
params.description: Folder to move files under. Each file's name is its path inside it (e.g. Pistol/Slide/shot.wav); absolute paths and ".." are refused.

params.name: create_dirs
params.label: Create Folders
params.description: Create missing folders under the destination. Off refuses the run when a folder is missing.

nodeTypes.name: file-rename
nodeTypes.label: Rename Files
nodeTypes.description: Transform filenames using patterns, find/replace, case rules, counters, and sanitization.

params.name: sanitize
params.label: Sanitize
params.description: Clean the filename before other transforms

params.name: separator
params.label: Separator
params.description: Character to replace spaces and special characters (used with Sanitize)

params.name: max_length
params.label: Max Length
params.description: Maximum filename length after sanitize (0 = no limit)

params.name: find
params.label: Find
params.description: Text or regex pattern to search for in the filename

params.name: replace
params.label: Replace
params.description: Replacement text (used with Find)

params.name: case
params.label: Case
params.description: Transform the filename to a specific case

params.name: prefix
params.label: Prefix
params.description: Text to prepend to the filename

params.name: suffix
params.label: Suffix
params.description: Text to append before the file extension

params.name: pattern
params.label: Pattern
params.description: Template for the output filename (supports {{name}}, {{ext}}, {{index}}, {{date}}, {{counter}})

params.name: counter_start
params.label: Counter Start
params.description: Starting number for the {{counter}} variable

params.name: counter_pad
params.label: Counter Padding
params.description: Zero-pad width for the counter (e.g., 3 → 001, 002)

params.name: extension
params.label: Extension
params.description: Replace the file extension (without dot)

nodeTypes.name: file-render
nodeTypes.label: Render Text File
nodeTypes.description: Write one text file from a template: a header, one row per item, then a footer.

params.name: header
params.label: Header
params.description: Written once before the rows. Reads {{count}} (the number of items) and run templates such as {{vars.X}} or {{node.<id>.<key>}}.

params.name: row
params.label: Row
params.description: Written once per item. {{item.KEY}} is that item's metadata value KEY (a key it lacks fails the run, naming the item); {{file}} is its file name.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer
params.description: Written once after the rows. Reads what the header reads.

params.name: separator
params.label: Separator
params.description: Put between rows. Header, rows and footer are each on their own line, and the file ends with a newline.

params.name: filename
params.label: File Name
params.description: Name of the file written, e.g. report.md (.md is text/markdown, anything else text/plain). Reads run templates, not {{item.*}}.

params.name: escape
params.label: Escape Values
params.description:
How values put into a row are escaped; the template text never is. markdown puts a backslash before \ ` * _ [ ] < > | and turns line breaks into
, so a value can't break a table cell.

nodeTypes.name: file-sort
nodeTypes.label: Sort Files
nodeTypes.description: Reorder items by one or more metadata fields, each ascending or descending.

params.name: by
params.label: Sort By
params.description: Metadata fields to sort by, separated by commas; later fields break ties. A leading '-' sorts that field descending. Numbers sort numerically; items missing a field (or with it null or empty) go last.

params.name: case
params.label: Letter Case
params.description: How text compares: as written, by Unicode code point (upper case before lower), or ignoring case.

nodeTypes.name: group
nodeTypes.label: Group
nodeTypes.description: Container for child nodes. Orchestrates sequential or parallel execution.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: How child nodes execute — sequentially (one after another) or in parallel (concurrently).

nodeTypes.name: http-request
nodeTypes.label: HTTP Request
nodeTypes.description: Make HTTP requests to APIs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.).

nodeTypes.name: image-compress
nodeTypes.label: Compress Images
nodeTypes.description: Reduce image file size while maintaining quality.

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: image-convert
nodeTypes.label: Convert Image Format
nodeTypes.description: Convert images between JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.

params.name: format
params.label: Output Format
params.description: The target image format to convert to

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: image-overlay
nodeTypes.label: Overlay Image
nodeTypes.description: Overlay an image onto source images at a configurable position, size, and opacity.

params.name: overlay
params.label: Overlay Image
params.description: The image to overlay (base64-encoded).

params.name: position
params.label: Position
params.description: Where to place the overlay on the image.

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.description: Overlay width as a percentage of the source image width.

params.name: opacity
params.label: Opacity
params.description: Overlay transparency (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque).

params.name: offsetX
params.label: Offset X
params.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the position. Positive = right, negative = left.

params.name: offsetY
params.label: Offset Y
params.description: Vertical pixel offset from the position. Positive = down, negative = up.

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: image-pad
nodeTypes.label: Pad Images
nodeTypes.description: Center images on a larger canvas, filling the added space with transparency or a color.

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.description: Canvas width in pixels. Leave empty to keep the image's width.

params.name: height
params.label: Height
params.description: Canvas height in pixels. Leave empty to keep the image's height.

params.name: background
params.label: Background
params.description: Fill for the added space: "transparent" or a hex color (#fff, #ffffff, #ffffff80). JPEG has no transparency, so a transparent fill comes out white.

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: image-resize
nodeTypes.label: Resize Images
nodeTypes.description: Change image dimensions while maintaining quality.

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.description: Target width in pixels

params.name: height
params.label: Height
params.description: Target height in pixels

params.name: maintainAspect
params.label: Maintain Aspect Ratio
params.description: Keep the original width-to-height ratio. With both width and height set, the image fits inside that box

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: image-strip-exif
nodeTypes.label: Strip EXIF
nodeTypes.description: Remove all EXIF metadata from images (GPS, camera info, timestamps).

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

nodeTypes.name: input
nodeTypes.label: Input
nodeTypes.description: Declares how data enters the recipe.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: How data is provided to the recipe.

params.name: accept
params.label: Accepted MIME Types
params.description: MIME types accepted (e.g., "image/jpeg", "image/png"). Derived from extensions.

params.name: extensions
params.label: File Extensions
params.description: File extensions accepted (e.g., ".jpg", ".png").

params.name: label
params.label: Label
params.description: Human-readable label for the input control.

params.name: multiple
params.label: Multiple
params.description: Whether multiple files or items are accepted.

params.name: maxFileSize
params.label: Max File Size
params.description: Maximum file size in bytes. 0 = no limit.

params.name: maxFiles
params.label: Max Files
params.description: Maximum number of files. 0 = no limit.

params.name: placeholder
params.label: Placeholder
params.description: Placeholder text for text or URL input.

nodeTypes.name: loop
nodeTypes.label: Loop
nodeTypes.description: Iterate over arrays (forEach), repeat N times, or loop while condition.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: How the loop iterates: over items, N times, or while a condition holds.

params.name: items
params.label: Items
params.description: Optional template expression for the item source. The Rust engine iterates over the incoming file batch by default — this is only needed for custom data sources.

params.name: count
params.label: Count
params.description: Number of times to repeat.

params.name: condition
params.label: Condition
params.description: Expr expression that must evaluate to true to continue looping.

params.name: breakCondition
params.label: Break Condition
params.description: Optional expr expression — breaks out of the loop early when true.

nodeTypes.name: output
nodeTypes.label: Output
nodeTypes.description: Declares how results are delivered.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: How results are delivered to the user.

params.name: directory
params.label: Output Directory
params.description: Output directory path. Supports {{ctx.date}}, {{ctx.timestamp}} templates.

params.name: filename
params.label: Filename Template
params.description: Filename template for output files.

params.name: zip
params.label: ZIP Multiple
params.description: Auto-zip when there are multiple output files.

params.name: label
params.label: Label
params.description: Label for the download button or display section.

params.name: autoDownload
params.label: Auto-Download
params.description: Automatically download results on completion.

nodeTypes.name: parallel
nodeTypes.label: Parallel
nodeTypes.description: Execute tasks concurrently with configurable worker pool and error strategy.

params.name: tasks
params.label: Tasks
params.description: Array of task definitions to execute concurrently.

params.name: maxWorkers
params.label: Max Workers
params.description: Maximum number of concurrent workers. Defaults to the number of tasks.

params.name: errorStrategy
params.label: Error Strategy
params.description: How to handle task errors — fail immediately or collect all results.

nodeTypes.name: report
nodeTypes.label: Report
nodeTypes.description: Print a templated line to the run's output; files pass through unchanged.

params.name: message
params.label: Message
params.description: The line to print, usually a template. {{file}} (the file's name) or {{item.<key>}} prints it once per file, {{entry.<key>}} (or {{entry}}) once per entry of each.

params.name: each
params.label: For Each
params.description: A list to print the message once per entry of, in order, usually a {{node.<id>.<key>}} template.

nodeTypes.name: shell-command
nodeTypes.label: Shell Command
nodeTypes.description: Execute shell commands with stall detection, retry, and streaming output. Still runs under bnto run --dry-run, so a recipe run dry uses it only to read.

params.name: command
params.label: Command
params.description: Binary to execute (e.g., 'ffmpeg', 'yt-dlp'). Must be on PATH.

params.name: args
params.label: Arguments
params.description: Command arguments: text, conditional groups (nested lists, dropped when any part is empty) and {"each": [...]} groups, repeated once per incoming file with {{path}}, {{file}} and {{item.KEY}} filled.

params.name: outputMode
params.label: Output Mode
params.description: How to collect output. 'stdout' captures command output. 'file' reads files written by the command to a temp directory (use {{output_dir}} in args to inject the path).

params.name: timeout
params.label: Timeout
params.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. Default: 300.

params.name: maxOutputSize
params.label: Max Output Size
params.description: Maximum size per output file in megabytes. Default: 100 MB.

params.name: env
params.label: Environment
params.description: Additional environment variables for the command.

params.name: search_path
params.label: Search Path
params.description: Folders to find the command in, in order, instead of PATH. The command is still a bare name and runs by its full path; relative folders are under the working directory.

params.name: cwd
params.label: Working Folder
params.description: Folder to run the command in, under the working directory (e.g. 'Tools'). Relative args are relative to it; search_path and {{output_dir}} are not. Absolute paths and ".." are refused.

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-clean
nodeTypes.label: Clean CSV
nodeTypes.description: Remove empty rows, trim whitespace, and deduplicate CSV data.

params.name: trimWhitespace
params.label: Trim Whitespace
params.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from every cell

params.name: removeEmptyRows
params.label: Remove Empty Rows
params.description: Skip rows where every cell is blank

params.name: removeDuplicates
params.label: Remove Duplicates
params.description: Remove duplicate rows, keeping the first occurrence

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-convert
nodeTypes.label: CSV to JSON
nodeTypes.description: Convert CSV data to JSON format with configurable delimiters.

params.name: delimiter
params.label: Delimiter
params.description: Column separator character

params.name: pretty
params.label: Pretty Print
params.description: Format output JSON with indentation

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-export
nodeTypes.label: Export Items as CSV
nodeTypes.description: Write the files passing through, with their metadata, as one CSV row each.

params.name: path
params.label: CSV Path
params.description: File to write, one row per file passing through; its folder must exist

params.name: name_column
params.label: Name Column
params.description: Header of the first column, which holds each file's name

params.name: overwrite
params.label: Overwrite
params.description: Replace a CSV already at the path; off keeps it (it may be an earlier run's record) and fails the run

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-lookup
nodeTypes.label: Look Up Rows
nodeTypes.description: Attach the CSV row whose key matches each file's name to that file.

params.name: table
params.label: Table
params.description: Path of the CSV (with a header row) to look each file up in

params.name: key_column
params.label: Key Column
params.description: Table column matched against each file; a key may appear on one row only

params.name: match_on
params.label: Match On
params.description: Which part of the file's name must equal the key exactly

params.name: unmatched
params.label: Unmatched Files
params.description: What happens to a file with no row: keep it (flagged unmatched: 1), drop it, or fail the run

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-merge
nodeTypes.label: Merge CSV
nodeTypes.description: Combine multiple CSV files into one with header reconciliation and deduplication.

params.name: headerHandling
params.label: Header Handling
params.description: How to reconcile headers across files

params.name: deduplicate
params.label: Remove Duplicates
params.description: Remove duplicate rows across all files

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-read
nodeTypes.label: Read Rows
nodeTypes.description: Explode a CSV or a JSON array into one item per row for loop iteration. Nested JSON fields read as dotted keys (meta.id).

params.name: format
params.label: Format
params.description: How the file is read: auto picks JSON for a .json file and CSV otherwise

params.name: hasHeaders
params.label: Has Headers
params.description: First row contains column headers (CSV only)

params.name: delimiter
params.label: Delimiter
params.description: Column separator character (CSV only)

params.name: maxRows
params.label: Max Rows
params.description: Maximum rows (CSV rows or JSON array elements) to process. Error if the file has more.

nodeTypes.name: spreadsheet-rename
nodeTypes.label: Rename CSV Columns
nodeTypes.description: Rename column headers in a CSV file.

params.name: columns
params.label: Column Mapping
params.description: Map of old column names to new names (e.g., {"Name": "full_name"})

nodeTypes.name: summarize
nodeTypes.label: Summarize
nodeTypes.description: Group items by fields; output one item per group with its count and field totals.

params.name: groupBy
params.label: Group By
params.description: Metadata fields to group items by, separated by commas; items whose values print the same share a group. Groups keep the order their first item arrived in. Items missing a field (or with it null or empty) group together, with that field null. Leave empty to summarize every item as one group.

params.name: sum
params.label: Sum
params.description: Numeric metadata fields to total per group, separated by commas; each total is written as sum_<field>. Numbers written as text count; blank values are skipped; any other value fails the run, naming the item.

nodeTypes.name: transform
nodeTypes.label: Transform
nodeTypes.description: Transform data using expressions (single value) or field mappings.

params.name: expression
params.label: Expression
params.description: Expr expression for a single transformation. Mutually exclusive with mappings.

params.name: mappings
params.label: Mappings
params.description: Map of field names to expr expressions for multi-field transformations. Mutually exclusive with expression.

nodeTypes.name: vector-optimize
nodeTypes.label: Optimize SVG
nodeTypes.description: Remove editor metadata, comments, and unnecessary elements from SVG files.

params.name: removeComments
params.label: Remove Comments
params.description: Strip XML comments from the SVG

params.name: removeMetadata
params.label: Remove Metadata
params.description: Strip <metadata> elements (RDF, Dublin Core, etc.)

params.name: collapseGroups
params.label: Collapse Groups
params.description: Remove empty groups and collapse single-child wrapper groups

params.name: minify
params.label: Minify
params.description: Remove unnecessary whitespace and newlines

params.name: precision
params.label: Numeric Precision
params.description: Decimal places for numeric values (reserved for Tier 2)

nodeTypes.name: vector-rasterize
nodeTypes.label: SVG to Image
nodeTypes.description: Convert SVG files to raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP).

params.name: format
params.label: Output Format
params.description: The target raster format to convert SVG to

params.name: quality
params.label: Quality
params.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). Applies to JPEG; PNG is lossless; WebP is lossless-only.

parameters.description: Folder every deleted file must be under. A file outside it (including through ".." or a link) refuses the run, so nothing is deleted.

processors.name: Filter Files
processors.description: Keep or drop files by extension, name or path pattern, and size. Files that match every criterion are kept (or dropped, with keep off).

parameters.name: extensions
parameters.label: Extensions
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to keep (e.g., "jpg,png,svg"). Leave empty to allow all extensions.

parameters.name: name_pattern
parameters.label: Name Pattern
parameters.description: Glob pattern to match against filenames (e.g., "photo*", "*.backup.*"). Uses glob syntax with * and ? wildcards.

parameters.name: pattern_mode
parameters.label: Pattern Mode
parameters.description: How to interpret the name pattern.

parameters.name: match
parameters.label: Match Against
parameters.description: What the name pattern is tested against: the file's name, or its whole relative path (folders separated by /).

parameters.name: keep
parameters.label: Keep Matches
parameters.description: When on, files matching every criterion are kept and the rest dropped. When off, matching files are dropped and the rest kept.

parameters.name: min_size
parameters.label: Minimum Size
parameters.description: Minimum file size in bytes. Files smaller than this are dropped.

parameters.name: max_size
parameters.label: Maximum Size
parameters.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Files larger than this are dropped. 0 means no limit.

processors.name: Join Files
processors.description: Join the files flowing in into one file, in the order they arrive, with an optional separator between them.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.label: File Name
parameters.description: Name of the joined file, e.g. README.md; its MIME type follows the extension. Reads run templates such as {{vars.X}}.

parameters.name: separator
parameters.label: Separator
parameters.description: Put between files, as written (a newline, a blank line, ---). Not before the first or after the last. Empty joins them directly.

processors.name: List Files
processors.description: Turn lists of paths into files: each listed path under a base folder that exists joins the pipeline; missing ones are skipped and counted. `entries` lists every path in order with its full path and status.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.label: Paths
parameters.description: Paths to list, relative to the base folder, added to any read from input files (one per line, or NUL-separated).

parameters.name: base
parameters.label: Base Folder
parameters.description: Folder the listed paths are relative to. Defaults to the working directory; absolute paths and ".." are refused.

processors.name: File Metadata
processors.description: Extract file metadata (folder, size, extension, MIME type, modified time, hash) and attach it to the pipeline output. `folder` is the item's folder in its relative name, `/`-separated (`a/b/c.mp4` gives `a/b`), empty at the top level.

parameters.name: include_hash
parameters.label: Include Hash
parameters.description: Compute and include a SHA-256 hash of the file content.

processors.name: Move Files
processors.description: Move files into folders under a destination, by the path in each file's name; refuses the whole run if any move would replace a file.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.label: Destination
parameters.description: Folder to move files under. Each file's name is its path inside it (e.g. Pistol/Slide/shot.wav); absolute paths and ".." are refused.

parameters.name: create_dirs
parameters.label: Create Folders
parameters.description: Create missing folders under the destination. Off refuses the run when a folder is missing.

processors.name: Rename Files
processors.description: Transform filenames using patterns, find/replace, case rules, and counters

parameters.name: sanitize
parameters.label: Sanitize
parameters.description: Clean the filename before other transforms

parameters.name: separator
parameters.label: Separator
parameters.description: Character to replace spaces and special characters (used with Sanitize)

parameters.name: max_length
parameters.label: Max Length
parameters.description: Maximum filename length after sanitize (0 = no limit)

parameters.name: find
parameters.label: Find
parameters.description: Text or regex pattern to search for in the filename

parameters.name: replace
parameters.label: Replace
parameters.description: Replacement text (used with Find)

parameters.name: case
parameters.label: Case
parameters.description: Transform the filename to a specific case

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.label: Prefix
parameters.description: Text to prepend to the filename

parameters.name: suffix
parameters.label: Suffix
parameters.description: Text to append before the file extension

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.label: Pattern
parameters.description: Template for the output filename (supports {{name}}, {{ext}}, {{index}}, {{date}}, {{counter}})

parameters.name: counter_start
parameters.label: Counter Start
parameters.description: Starting number for the {{counter}} variable

parameters.name: counter_pad
parameters.label: Counter Padding
parameters.description: Zero-pad width for the counter (e.g., 3 → 001, 002)

parameters.name: extension
parameters.label: Extension
parameters.description: Replace the file extension (without dot)

processors.name: Render Text File
processors.description: Write one text file from a template: a header, one row per item from its metadata, then a footer (a Markdown table, a report).

parameters.name: header
parameters.label: Header
parameters.description: Written once before the rows. Reads {{count}} (the number of items) and run templates such as {{vars.X}} or {{node.<id>.<key>}}.

parameters.name: row
parameters.label: Row
parameters.description: Written once per item. {{item.KEY}} is that item's metadata value KEY (a key it lacks fails the run, naming the item); {{file}} is its file name.

parameters.name: footer
parameters.label: Footer
parameters.description: Written once after the rows. Reads what the header reads.

parameters.name: separator
parameters.label: Separator
parameters.description: Put between rows. Header, rows and footer are each on their own line, and the file ends with a newline.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.label: File Name
parameters.description: Name of the file written, e.g. report.md (.md is text/markdown, anything else text/plain). Reads run templates, not {{item.*}}.

parameters.name: escape
parameters.label: Escape Values
parameters.description:
How values put into a row are escaped; the template text never is. markdown puts a backslash before \ ` * _ [ ] < > | and turns line breaks into
, so a value can't break a table cell.

processors.name: Sort Files
processors.description: Reorder items by one or more metadata fields, each ascending or descending (`source, -title`). Stable; numbers sort numerically, missing values last. Data and metadata are untouched.

parameters.name: by
parameters.label: Sort By
parameters.description: Metadata fields to sort by, separated by commas; later fields break ties. A leading '-' sorts that field descending. Numbers sort numerically; items missing a field (or with it null or empty) go last.

parameters.name: case
parameters.label: Letter Case
parameters.description: How text compares: as written, by Unicode code point (upper case before lower), or ignoring case.

processors.name: Compress Images
processors.description: Reduce image file size while maintaining quality

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Convert Image Format
processors.description: Convert images between JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats. Also accepts SVG input.

parameters.name: format
parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.description: The target image format to convert to

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Overlay Image
processors.description: Overlay an image onto source images at a configurable position, size, and opacity.

parameters.name: overlay
parameters.label: Overlay Image
parameters.description: The image to overlay (base64-encoded).

parameters.name: position
parameters.label: Position
parameters.description: Where to place the overlay on the image.

parameters.name: size
parameters.label: Size
parameters.description: Overlay width as a percentage of the source image width.

parameters.name: opacity
parameters.label: Opacity
parameters.description: Overlay transparency (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque).

parameters.name: offsetX
parameters.label: Offset X
parameters.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the position. Positive = right, negative = left.

parameters.name: offsetY
parameters.label: Offset Y
parameters.description: Vertical pixel offset from the position. Positive = down, negative = up.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Pad Images
processors.description: Center images on a larger canvas, filling the added space with transparency or a color.

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: Canvas width in pixels. Leave empty to keep the image's width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Canvas height in pixels. Leave empty to keep the image's height.

parameters.name: background
parameters.label: Background
parameters.description: Fill for the added space: "transparent" or a hex color (#fff, #ffffff, #ffffff80). JPEG has no transparency, so a transparent fill comes out white.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Resize Images
processors.description: Change image dimensions while maintaining quality

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: Target width in pixels

parameters.name: height
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Target height in pixels

parameters.name: maintainAspect
parameters.label: Maintain Aspect Ratio
parameters.description: Keep the original width-to-height ratio. With both width and height set, the image fits inside that box

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Strip EXIF
processors.description: Remove all EXIF metadata from images (GPS, camera info, timestamps)

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). WebP is lossless-only; quality has no effect until lossy WebP support is added.

processors.name: Report
processors.description: Print a templated line to the run's output: once, once per file, or once per entry of a list; files pass through unchanged.

parameters.name: message
parameters.label: Message
parameters.description: The line to print, usually a template. {{file}} (the file's name) or {{item.<key>}} prints it once per file, {{entry.<key>}} (or {{entry}}) once per entry of each.

parameters.name: each
parameters.label: For Each
parameters.description: A list to print the message once per entry of, in order, usually a {{node.<id>.<key>}} template.

processors.name: Shell Command
processors.description: Execute external CLI tools with security validation.

parameters.name: command
parameters.label: Command
parameters.description: Binary to execute (e.g., 'ffmpeg', 'yt-dlp'). Must be on PATH.

parameters.name: args
parameters.label: Arguments
parameters.description: Command arguments: text, conditional groups (nested lists, dropped when any part is empty) and {"each": [...]} groups, repeated once per incoming file with {{path}}, {{file}} and {{item.KEY}} filled.

parameters.name: outputMode
parameters.label: Output Mode
parameters.description: How to collect output. 'stdout' captures command output. 'file' reads files written by the command to a temp directory (use {{output_dir}} in args to inject the path).

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.label: Timeout
parameters.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. Default: 300.

parameters.name: maxOutputSize
parameters.label: Max Output Size
parameters.description: Maximum size per output file in megabytes. Default: 100 MB.

parameters.name: env
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.description: Additional environment variables for the command.

parameters.name: search_path
parameters.label: Search Path
parameters.description: Folders to find the command in, in order, instead of PATH. The command is still a bare name and runs by its full path; relative folders are under the working directory.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.label: Working Folder
parameters.description: Folder to run the command in, under the working directory (e.g. 'Tools'). Relative args are relative to it; search_path and {{output_dir}} are not. Absolute paths and ".." are refused.

processors.name: Clean CSV
processors.description: Remove empty rows, trim whitespace, and deduplicate CSV data

parameters.name: trimWhitespace
parameters.label: Trim Whitespace
parameters.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from every cell

parameters.name: removeEmptyRows
parameters.label: Remove Empty Rows
parameters.description: Skip rows where every cell is blank

parameters.name: removeDuplicates
parameters.label: Remove Duplicates
parameters.description: Remove duplicate rows, keeping the first occurrence

processors.name: CSV to JSON
processors.description: Convert CSV rows to a JSON array of objects

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.label: Delimiter
parameters.description: Column separator character

parameters.name: pretty
parameters.label: Pretty Print
parameters.description: Format output JSON with indentation

processors.name: Export Items as CSV
processors.description: Write the files passing through, with their metadata, as one CSV row each

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: CSV Path
parameters.description: File to write, one row per file passing through; its folder must exist

parameters.name: name_column
parameters.label: Name Column
parameters.description: Header of the first column, which holds each file's name

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.label: Overwrite
parameters.description: Replace a CSV already at the path; off keeps it (it may be an earlier run's record) and fails the run

processors.name: Look Up Rows
processors.description: Attach the CSV row whose key matches each file's name to that file

parameters.name: table
parameters.label: Table
parameters.description: Path of the CSV (with a header row) to look each file up in

parameters.name: key_column
parameters.label: Key Column
parameters.description: Table column matched against each file; a key may appear on one row only

parameters.name: match_on
parameters.label: Match On
parameters.description: Which part of the file's name must equal the key exactly

parameters.name: unmatched
parameters.label: Unmatched Files
parameters.description: What happens to a file with no row: keep it (flagged unmatched: 1), drop it, or fail the run

processors.name: Merge CSV
processors.description: Combine multiple CSV files into one, with header reconciliation and deduplication.

parameters.name: headerHandling
parameters.label: Header Handling
parameters.description: How to reconcile headers across files

parameters.name: deduplicate
parameters.label: Remove Duplicates
parameters.description: Remove duplicate rows across all files

processors.name: Read Rows
processors.description: Explode a CSV or a JSON array into one item per row for loop iteration. Nested JSON fields read as dotted keys (meta.id)

parameters.name: format
parameters.label: Format
parameters.description: How the file is read: auto picks JSON for a .json file and CSV otherwise

parameters.name: hasHeaders
parameters.label: Has Headers
parameters.description: First row contains column headers (CSV only)

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.label: Delimiter
parameters.description: Column separator character (CSV only)

parameters.name: maxRows
parameters.label: Max Rows
parameters.description: Maximum rows (CSV rows or JSON array elements) to process. Error if the file has more.

processors.name: Rename CSV Columns
processors.description: Rename column headers in a CSV file

parameters.name: columns
parameters.label: Column Mapping
parameters.description: Map of old column names to new names (e.g., {"Name": "full_name"})

processors.name: Summarize
processors.description: Group items by metadata fields and output one item per group with its count and the totals of numeric fields (sum_<field>). Groups keep first-seen order; the items summarized don't pass through.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.label: Group By
parameters.description: Metadata fields to group items by, separated by commas; items whose values print the same share a group. Groups keep the order their first item arrived in. Items missing a field (or with it null or empty) group together, with that field null. Leave empty to summarize every item as one group.

parameters.name: sum
parameters.label: Sum
parameters.description: Numeric metadata fields to total per group, separated by commas; each total is written as sum_<field>. Numbers written as text count; blank values are skipped; any other value fails the run, naming the item.

processors.name: Optimize SVG
processors.description: Optimize SVG files by removing editor metadata, comments, and unnecessary elements

parameters.name: removeComments
parameters.label: Remove Comments
parameters.description: Strip XML comments from the SVG

parameters.name: removeMetadata
parameters.label: Remove Metadata
parameters.description: Strip <metadata> elements (RDF, Dublin Core, etc.)

parameters.name: collapseGroups
parameters.label: Collapse Groups
parameters.description: Remove empty groups and collapse single-child wrapper groups

parameters.name: minify
parameters.label: Minify
parameters.description: Remove unnecessary whitespace and newlines

parameters.name: precision
parameters.label: Numeric Precision
parameters.description: Decimal places for numeric values (reserved for Tier 2)

processors.name: SVG to Image
processors.description: Convert SVG files to raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP)

parameters.name: format
parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.description: The target raster format to convert SVG to

parameters.name: quality
parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Output quality (1 = lowest, 100 = highest). Applies to JPEG; PNG is lossless; WebP is lossless-only.

Definition.description: A single node in a .bnto.json recipe. Can contain child nodes (recursive).

always.description: Closing step: run even after an earlier node in the same chain failed, like `finally`. The run still fails with the first error.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the recipe.

parameters.description: Configuration parameters (key-value pairs).

parentId.description: Optional parent node id (for nested nodes).

position.description: The node's position on the visual editor canvas.

Edge.description: A connection between two nodes in the pipeline graph.

source.description: The id of the source node (where data flows FROM).

sourceHandle.description: Optional: which output port on the source node.

target.description: The id of the target node (where data flows TO).

targetHandle.description: Optional: which input port on the target node.

Metadata.description: Descriptive metadata about the node (description, timestamps, tags).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this node was created.

customData.description: Open-ended key-value pairs for consumer-specific data.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this node does.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.

PipelineSettings.description: Recipe-level settings that control execution behavior.

iteration.description: How the executor handles iteration over multiple input files. 'auto' wraps primitive sequences in implicit per-file loops; 'explicit' (default) executes exactly what's defined.

Port.description: A connection point on a node (input or output).

handle.description: Optional handle identifier used by the visual editor for positioning.

id.description: Unique identifier for this port within its node.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the port.

definitionSchema.description: A .bnto.json recipe definition. Describes a pipeline of nodes that process data.
definitionSchema.title: Bnto Definition
